_comment: Human-confirmed field/venue identity across leagues. The converter NEVER auto-merges differently-named records; this file is the confirmation step. Keys: '<venue>' -> canonical venue, '<venue>|<field>' -> canonical '<venue>|<field>', or '|<field>' -> venue for a field whose own `location` is empty.
_rejected_comment: Pairs a human has confirmed are DISTINCT. Decided 2026-08-31 by Greg. The suggester matches on coordinates, but 1.0 stores ONE geocode per venue, so every field at a venue shares it and distance can never discriminate within a venue — these are that blind spot, not real duplicates. The two Azalea Cages pairs are the same artifact, surfaced only after the cages were correctly placed into Azalea Road Park: a batting cage is not a ball diamond.
_rejected: Azalea Road Park|Dirt<->Azalea Road Park|Azalea Cages
Azalea Road Park|Turf<->Azalea Road Park|Azalea Cages
_event_fields_comment: Which field a free-text special event belongs on, keyed by the 1.0 event id. One raw string ('Azelea') covers a clinic, a 12-hour tournament and a team party, so a string->field table cannot express this; the event id can. Value is a list of 'Venue|Field'; several means a block per field (the event occupies each); [] means the event deliberately occupies no field. Decided 2026-08-31 by Greg.

_team_identity_comment: Cross-org team identity: the same real-world team as each league names it. Two rows sharing a key are one team. Confirmed by Greg 2026-08-31 — NEVER inferred from names, which differ between leagues and are misspelt in real data ('Force (Hererra)' vs 'Force (16U) Herrera'). Without this, one interleague game recorded in both leagues reads as a cross-org double-booking; the first data load produced four such false conflicts. Format: key -> ['Org|Team', ...].
